atlas-nz.0112: With an offer from an NZQA-accredited provider, the first year’s fees paid, a return ticket and approved insurance. Courses of up to three months need only the NZeTA.
atlas-nz.0113: Up to 25 hours a week in term for visas granted since 3 November 2025, full time in breaks; no self-employment.
atlas-nz.0116: Money parked in the account just before applying is refused: funds need a three-to-six-month history.
atlas-nz.0118: A placement required by your foreign university needs a Student and Trainee Work Visa, with the agreement between university and host. Others use the working holiday or a Specific Purpose Work Visa.
atlas-nz.0120: An open work visa, once in a lifetime: three years after a New Zealand master’s (30 weeks of study) or PhD, up to three after a bachelor’s. Apply within three months of the student visa expiring.
atlas-nz.0121: While the application is pending you hold an interim visa with visitor conditions: you may not work.
atlas-nz.0123: Three steps: the employer is accredited, passes a job check showing no local candidate, then you apply with its token. You need three years of relevant experience or a level-4 qualification, a full-time contract and no 90-day trial clause.
atlas-nz.0124: Skilled roles get up to five years; lower-skilled ones three, then twelve months abroad.
atlas-nz.0125: at least the market rate, and NZ$23.95 an hour
atlas-nz.0126: Skilled Migrant Category and Green List
atlas-nz.0127: Residence needs six points from a recognised degree, a New Zealand professional registration or high pay, plus years of skilled work in New Zealand, always with a skilled job offer. Green List Tier 1 roles, such as software or civil engineers and doctors, go straight to residence.
atlas-nz.0128: Visiting academics and researchers come on a Specific Purpose Work Visa with the host’s form; thesis research for a foreign university on a Student and Trainee Work Visa.
atlas-nz.0129: International PhD students pay domestic fees, may work full time, their partners get open work visas and their children attend state school free. A PhD gives all six residence points.
atlas-nz.0133: Terms depend on your country. For Italians, aged 18 to 30: 12 months, no cap, at most three months with one employer, no permanent jobs, up to six months of study.
atlas-nz.0135: British citizens can apply up to age 35 and stay up to three years.
atlas-nz.0136: Visa-free with an NZeTA, valid two years: up to three months for EU citizens, six for British citizens, with no work.
atlas-nz.0137: NZ$17 in the app + NZ$100 levy
atlas-nz.0138: Long-stay visas ask for an acceptable standard of health and police certificates; get documents apostilled, and use only a licensed immigration adviser if you hire one.
atlas-nz.0139: Students, visitors and working holiday makers get no public health care: arrange comprehensive private insurance for the whole stay before you fly.
atlas-nz.0140: Banks must verify a physical address in New Zealand: if you are in a hostel or short-term rental, ask the manager for a stamped address letter or use your bank’s host-letter form.
atlas-nz.0141: Apply online at ird.govt.nz for an IRD number before you start work, with passport, visa, home tax number and an active New Zealand bank account; give your employer the tax code declaration (IR330), or 45% is withheld.
atlas-nz.0142: Public health care is only for residents, citizens and workers on visas of 2 years or more. The accident scheme ACC covers everyone in the country for injuries from accidents, but not illness.
atlas-nz.0143: Open an account at ANZ, ASB, BNZ or Westpac with your passport and proof of address; you need it to get your IRD number.
atlas-nz.0144: Apply for your next visa before yours expires to get an interim visa, but do not leave New Zealand: it ends the moment you depart. Moving from a student to a post-study work visa, the interim visa usually has visitor conditions, so you may not work while you wait.
atlas-nz.0145: An interim visa ends the moment you leave New Zealand, and your pending application with it.
atlas-nz.0146: Without an IRD number your pay is taxed at 45%.
atlas-nz.0147: Public healthcare is only for residents and those on work visas of two years or more; students and working holidaymakers need insurance. ACC covers accidents, not illness.
